data.one_liner: Widgets that follow other widgets using Leader and Follower links.
data.what_it_does: Provides Leader and Follower widgets allowing designated widgets to follow the position, movement, and sizing of another widget on screen. Includes support for offsets, aligners, boundaries, and ordering containers.
use_when: You need a widget to track and follow the position of another widget independently of standard layouts.
You are implementing floating elements like tooltips, popovers, or floating toolbars that need precise positioning relative to a leader.
avoid_when: Standard layout widgets like Row, Column, or Stack can achieve your desired arrangement.
You do not have a leader-follower relationship between widgets.
strengths: Allows follower widgets to bypass ancestor layout rules.
Supports custom aligners, boundaries, scaling, and keyboard-aware positioning.
weaknesses: Requires careful ordering where Leader widgets must be built before their Followers.
Unusual mental model compared to standard Flutter tree-based layouts.
